name: positions_with_mapping_counts
note: verifier: fiscal position form shows account and tax mappings per position (embedded account array, accountTaxRel links)
source_sql: SELECT p.id, p.company_id, p.auto_apply, p.active, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_fiscal_position_account a WHERE a.position_id = p.id) AS account_maps, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_fiscal_position_account_tax_rel t WHERE t.account_fiscal_position_id = p.id) AS tax_links, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_fiscal_position_res_country_state_rel s WHERE s.account_fiscal_position_id = p.id) AS states FROM account_fiscal_position p ORDER BY p.id
